verdict.rationale: Thoropass has in-product AI that works on customer data: First Pass AI pre-screens uploaded evidence before audit to catch common rejections, and GenAI DDQ autofills questionnaires from the user's library of previous questionnaires. These are narrow, task-specific uses rather than general insights and suggestions across the user's data. The AI Helpbot answers only from Thoropass support content, and the MCP server serves an external assistant, so neither counts here. missing for 10: a general in-product AI that surfaces insights and recommendations across workspace data, detail on what First Pass AI actually returns as suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
